rationale: Both Prajyot and Omnaath work at the intersection of simulation and robotics—Prajyot specializes in sim-to-real pipelines using Isaac Sim and ROS 2 for robot manipulation and locomotion, while Omnaath brings autonomous vehicle simulation experience at GM with C++ and Python expertise. Their complementary focus on simulation-driven robotics development and overlapping tech stack (C++, Python) creates natural ground for technical collaboration and knowledge exchange.
intro_message: Prajyot Patil, meet Omnaath Guptha Harihara Gupta — you both work on simulation-driven robotics systems and share a C++/Python foundation; comparing notes on sim-to-real challenges across mobile robots and autonomous vehicles could be valuable.
